title: 1Password coordinate data
description: Shape of .chezmoidata/secrets.yaml. Merged into the same template data as hosts.yaml. Each item names its 1Password title and vault; it cannot tell whether either exists, since only `op` knows that.

items.description: Short key -> item coordinates. The key is what templates write (.secrets.items.slskd); a hyphenated key needs `index`. A typo is caught at render time by missingkey=error.

vault.description: Vault holding this item. Named on every entry rather than inherited from a fleet default: an explicit value is greppable and cannot be got wrong by a fallback rule. A non-ASCII vault name works with onepassword/onepasswordItemFields/onepasswordDetailsFields, but an op:// secret reference rejects it.
